value_or_null.description: Original MM culture/ex-vivo study, not an animal study or clinical metformin trial. Header published December26 2014, paginated volume6 no5/2015. Preserve publication identity without inventing a later experiment.

Prior WM10/MM12/CLL11 expression comparison is reused historical context, accession GSE66910 as printed, not 33 new Met-treated patients. Own MM/MGUS panel cohort N/raw accession not verified. HSPA5 largest in MM/MGUS top panel, HSPA8 largest resistant/naive bottom panel; HSPA5 up but not top in both.

RPMI8226 exposed to increasing Btz for six months; source reports 5-10 fold IC50 resistance relative vehicle .5%DMSO parental context. Full underlying resistance curve/raw IC50 not reproduced; not eradication of clinical resistance.
Confocal Met1mM/Btz10nM18h, Figure2F Western Met2/4mM with Btz3nM18h. XTT72h Met0/.5/1/2/4/8mM or phenformin0/20/40/100/200/500uM plus Btz2nM. Do not transfer one concentration or time to all assays.

Body calls Met alone and pair GRP78 suppression, but Fig1D quantitation places both above untreated baseline while below Btz alone. Fig1C Met image is bright. Suppression relative Btz induction is qualified, not uniform below-baseline GRP78 loss; exact graph means not digitized.

Control aggresome fluorescence body folds Btz11 P<.001/Met8 P<.004/pair41 P<.0001. HSPA5 knockdown reduces GRP78 but aggresomes still form and accumulate, so GRP78 not necessary for aggresome formation. Fold fluorescence not percentage dead cells.

Individual ATF6/IRE1/PERK knockdown retains Btz GRP78 induction, qPCR validation reported. Does not establish all UPR pathways dispensable under every condition; exact knockdown completeness/raw measurements not verified.

Body says Met does not induce autophagosomes yet reports Met approximately4-fold fluorescence P<.001 versus untreated, Btz approximately12-fold P<.0001. Pair lower than Btz P<.0001 and Met P<.02. Static staining/colocalization is not direct dynamic flux or delivery rate; no uniform zero autophagy claim.
Patient CD138+ cells show analogous aggresome/autophagosome images ex vivo, donor N and donor-level response distribution unknown. Not treated-patient clinical benefit or independent patient count.

Methods pCMV-GRP78-myc-P495L and body substrate-binding mutant, plots label GRP78-KDEL. Figure4A/B captions control pcDNA3.1 versus mutant, body/images WT versus mutant. Preserve construct/comparator inconsistency; do not identify P495L as a verified KDEL deletion.

Body says WT but not mutant associates with p62/HDAC6/LC3B/KDEL receptor. Fig4C visually retains HDAC6 and KDEL receptor bands in mutant lanes, especially mutant+Btz KDEL band. Do not accept categorical absence of all four interactions; qualitative blot/body discrepancy unresolved, input/IP efficiency and stoichiometry not verified.

Mutant impairs autophagosomes while aggresomes persist. Btz sensitivity increases at some concentrations, Fig4E curves converge at high5/10/20nM. Not uniform complete resistance eradication, direct Met binding, or specific WT rescue of Met action.

Met and phenformin enhance Btz2nM72h XTT effects in MM lines. Body calls synergy, but no formal CI/interaction model in main report. XTT metabolic viability not a direct cell-death count; some low-dose readouts nonmonotonic, no exact curve means digitized.

AMPK WT/DKO experiments use MEFs, not MM AMPK knockout. Drug effects persist but source allows residual activity/alternative pathways. Figure5B MEF apoptosis is not MM apoptosis or universal AMPK independence.

HSPA5 knockdown in U266 with Btz enhances cleaved caspase3/8/10 and PARP. Figure6B axis0/4/6/12/24 has no explicit unit; exact time/dose identity not silently supplied. No Met-specific apoptosis attribution from this genetic Btz comparison.

Methods all in vitro triplicate and repeated at least twice with representative experiment; Fig3 images at least three experiments. Not all n3 independent, triplicates not three donors. No complete image/cell N, power, blinding/random allocation or posthoc/multiplicity plan verified.

Source explicitly notes millimolar Met IC50 far above exposure achievable at maximum human oral dose. Earlier physiological wording is not PK validation. No own clinical Met outcomes/animals/normal-cell selectivity/toxicity/neuropathy benefit; phenformin clinical risk and historical trial counts are background, not current guidance.

CAL23 Jagannathan2015 and this same-group report have very similar confocal representations/shared mechanistic context, including CAL23Fig3e versus this Fig1C and related HSPA5 panels. Exact raw image/sample provenance unchecked; do not assume new independent samples or mechanistic replication, infer cause or allege misconduct.

Colocalization, knockdown and mutant phenotypes support a GRP78 pathway candidate but not direct Met-GRP78 binding, exclusive causal mechanism or measured aggresome trafficking rate. No accepted downstream clinical mechanistic support.

Cincinnati/Assiut authors; UC translational award, Egyptian-US joint program, Egyptian Ministry Higher Education scholarship for MAY. No conflict as declared. UC IRB approval without ID/consent detail. Own all13 text/Fig1-6 visual3-8 read; raw data/companions/protocol/current integrity unchecked, no acquisition.
